data.message: I opt in to 18 tons, even if others choose 10—not an all-or-nothing deal. Each of the other 24: state your exact intended catch and any conditions. Switching 10→18 adds $8,000 now if fulfilled. If k choose 18 and all others 10, catch=250+8k, remaining=250−8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500−16k (25%). At k=25, 50 remain; next stock is 500 or 100. Intentions aren't enforceable; other catches need recalculation. This isn't guaranteed best long-term. Who will opt in?
